findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

An employee was observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet, thus re-contaminating their hands. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to review hand washing with staff. Ensure safe hand washing procedures are taking place at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

An employee was observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. The PIC was notified and instructed to review hand washing procedures with all staff. Ensure that freshly cleaned hands are protected from recontamination by using a clean barrier or other method to turn off the faucet. Education conducted.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The sani bucket next to the espresso machine is observed low on the inspector’s test strips. The PIC was notified and remade the bucket during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the  SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

A measuring device was not available in the facility for ensuring that the dish machine is reaching critical temperature at the surface of the dishes. The options were discussed with he PIC and they are instructed to acquire one prior to the follow up in two weeks,

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools. 

The mop is observed stored with the head laying in the mop sink. The mop was moved during the inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The hand sink in the dry storage area as well as the three part sink are observed pulling away from the wall and leaving a crack that is not easily cleanable. PIC is instructed to ensure that the sinks are sealed to the wall so that they provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. 

Two locations under the sink and ice bin at the north end of the prep are are observed with the floor to wall coving damaged and in need of repair. The locations appear to be possible water retention locations and are not in easily cleanable spots due to pipes nearby. PIC is instructed to ensure that they are repaired prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Boxes of single service items (straws, etc) observed stored on the floor on the McDonalds side of the barista area. Store single service items at least 6 inches above the ground to prevent contamination and facilitate cleaning around stored items.
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. [C]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: One live and three dead cockroaches observed under both espresso machines. Maintain premises free of pests by pest control, cleaning, and inspecting deliveries. Inspector will follow up on pest control in 10 days. Reference 6-501.11 (Pf)

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: PIC has not completed certified food manager training. Ensure there is a CFM present at all times of prep and service.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12 (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. (C)

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: Cockroaches observed, live, in the barista area, near the handwashing sink. The premises shall be maintained free of insects, rodents and other pests. Eliminate cockroaches, using proper pest control processes as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; and (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests. (Pf)

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Soiled CBS Coffee pump stored in a soiled container with apparently clean pumps. Clean pumps and container. Prevent future contamination during storage. CORRECTED- Items were removed from storage to be cleaned.
4-903.11(A), (B) and (D) Equipment, Utensils, Linens and Single-Use Articles shall be stored: 1) in a clean and dry location; 2) away or protected from contamination; 3) at least six inches above the floor; 4) covered or inverted. (C)

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Maximum registering irreversible thermometer is not available to the employees to measure sanitizing temperature of the dish machine. Provide a measuring device so the employees can measure temperatures and ensure proper sanitization.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. (Pf)

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: No Certified Food Manager (CFM) present at time of inspection. Medium-risk facilities must have a CFM present at all times of operation. PIC stated that employees are in the process of becoming CFMs through an online class and proctored exam.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12 (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment: Observed wet wiping cloth stored on the counter in the barista area. Wiping cloths must be stored submerged in sanitizer solution. CORRECTED- Wiping cloth was returned to sanitizer.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14 (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114. (C)

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed the display cooler below the "Welcome to Starbucks" sign to be out of temperature. Thermometer in the unit was reading at 50F. Greek yogurt within the cooler was probed at 47F-53F at varying depths within the cooler. All perishable/keep refrigerated items were pulled and discarded from this unit since there is no knowledge as to when the cooler began malfunctioning. Items discarded were: 9 Greek Yogurts, 6 String Cheeses, 9 Strawberry Evolution Harvest Juices, 3 Orange Juice Evolution Harvest, and 2 Sweet Greens Evolution Harvest juices. Ensure that when storing ready to eat PHFs that the cooler is monitored to ensure that the food is not removed from temperature. 
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed an ice scoop being stored in the ice bin with the handle touching the ice. Ensure that if an ice scoop is being stored in the ice that the handle does not touch the ice. 
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a hose for the floor cleaner attached to the mop sink faucet that had a considerable leak noted. Ensure that all plumbing and plumbing attachments are maintained in good repair.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink in the back storage area to have the caulking in disrepair. Ensure that the hand sink is recaulked to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
Observed that the toaster oven unit had some soil inside on the door.
Clean this equipment as necessary.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: The bottom edges of the doors of the cabinets under the brewer and the hand sink in the front of house are in disrepair. The laminate is curling up. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Repair cabinets so that they are easily cleavable.
